before_metrics.comment: exp-20260530-022 found the composite alpha_score degenerate/inverted on FILLED core trades (56/61 top_decile, 0 below top_quartile; relative_strength and breadth_alignment invert). The full-universe view was the declared next step with a real bottom comparison group.

change_summary: Scores the FULL daily candidate universe (filled + unfilled) on every 5th trading day across the canonical 3 windows using entry_day_ranking_attribution._context_for_asof, computes 5/10/20-day close-to-close forward returns per ranked ticker, and buckets all 3551 (day,ticker) observations by alpha_score quintile/decile. Result: a real but top-quantile-concentrated, NON-monotonic edge. Pooled Q5-Q1 spread +0.56pp(5d)/+1.51pp(10d)/+3.98pp(20d), growing with horizon and NOT jackpot-driven (Q5 top5 positive share 0.088). But the quintile ladder is non-monotonic at every horizon (Q1 beats Q2/Q3 at 5d) and mid_weak window is negative (-0.46pp 5d), so only 2/3 windows positive. Honest downgrade from clean accept to observed_only.
decision_rule: Accept only if pooled top-quintile minus bottom-quintile 5d forward return >= 0.005 AND a majority of windows show positive spread AND the pooled quintile avg-return ladder is monotonic increasing AND every pooled quintile has >= 30 obs. A top-vs-bottom edge without a clean ladder is observed_only. Reject if pooled 5d spread <= -0.005.

gate_questions.what_hypothesis: The composite alpha_score has monotonic forward-return predictive power on the full daily candidate universe (filled + unfilled).
gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260530-022 (filled-trade degenerate/inverted); exp-20260528-007 (expectation increment to ranking, no edge).
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: Full-universe PIT alpha_score quantile bucket vs forward return.
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: Monotonic quintile ladder + majority-positive windows + >= 0.5pp 5d top-bottom spread.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Deterministic: load 3 ohlcv snapshots, sample every 5th day, score full universe PIT, bucket. 9 unit tests cover forward returns, bucketing, ladder monotonicity, and gate branches.

hypothesis: The composite cross-sectional alpha_score has monotonic forward-return predictive power on the FULL daily candidate universe (filled and unfilled), which exp-20260530-022 could not test because filled core trades concentrate into the top rank bucket. Scoring every ticker on sampled trading days across the canonical 3 windows and bucketing all (day,ticker) observations by alpha_score quintile/decile against 5/10/20-day forward returns reveals whether the ranking surface carries real cross-sectional alpha.
next_evidence_needed: Use alpha_score as a top-decile/top-quintile SELECTION signal (e.g. a default-off paper sleeve observing top-decile names daily), not a full-universe monotonic sizing weight, since the middle/bottom ranks carry no ordering information. Confirm robustness on a 4th+ non-overlapping window (mid_weak is negative). Decompose the Q5 edge by component to check whether it is just the trend/relative_strength weight the core already trades on (then it is not new alpha) or something incremental.

prediction.outcome_vs_prediction: matched: edge concentrated in top quantile without monotonic ladder, one window (mid_weak) negative.
